title: Flash flood emergency in Fort Mill and Rock Hill
summary: Extreme rain over eastern York County. NWS issues a Flash Flood Warning with a catastrophic damage threat. Shows the Danger level.

alerts.headline: FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY FOR FORT MILL AND EASTERN ROCK HILL
alerts.description:
SIMULATED ALERT. ...FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY FOR FORT MILL AND EASTERN ROCK HILL...

This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

* WHAT...Life-threatening flash flooding of creeks, streams, and roads.
* WHERE...Sugar Creek, Wildcat Creek, and Tools Fork.
* IMPACTS...Water rescues are in progress. Many roads are flooded.
alerts.instruction: SIMULATED. Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
